title: Mochizuki Honami — Guiding Resolve〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for working with me again today, Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure.
You've improved quite a lot compared to our first day, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have?! Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Also, about that blister...
Please don't forget to treat it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
First, cool it down with ice water or the like.
And whatever you do, don't let it pop.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. This isn't my first one, so I should be able to give it the proper treatment.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I won't tell you to stop practicing until the day you're supposed to play.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But please try to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You've come this far, so I want to see you put on the best performance you can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate the concern.

School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm running a little late...
The others are probably already here.)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, KAITO.
Have the others already arrived?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they're in that classroom over there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Honami, your hand...
It has a bandage on it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, this?
I have a blister...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Does it hurt...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, not all that much.
But I do plan on taking it easy during practice today just in case.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That seems wise...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we head over...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that sound...
I guess they've already started practicing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (To be fair, it's better for them not to waste time waiting for me to arrive since they already knew I'd be running late...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They've been practicing since this morning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, I thought we were starting this evening.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry!
I messed up the same part again!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
Would a quick break help...?
That might help you regain your focus.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line:
But Honami's going to get here soon.
I'd like to be ready to go when she does...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line:
Me too.
Can you keep going, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Hona's working super hard, so I wanna do the same!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: You can do it, Sakki, Ichi, Shih!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Does that mean today isn't their first time doing this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They didn't want just you to be working so hard...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Alright, one last time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: Okay! Let's do our best to perform like we never have before!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We absolutely need to do our best!
